title: Boarding catalogue GET kept advertising the old per-pet price after Pricing Control was activated, while the quote POST on the same page charged the new one
reproduction: scratchpad repro calling the real GET and POST handlers of both commercial routes against one database, before and after activating an operator price in Pricing Control (service_packages), with dynamic_pricing_rules emptied so the number is unambiguous.

measured_before.boarding_before_activation: GET packages [{boarding-4h 499},{boarding-10h 599},{boarding-24h 699}]; POST quote base 699, 2 units, 2 pets -> 2796.
measured_before.boarding_after_activation_at_2500: GET packages UNCHANGED [{boarding-4h 499},{boarding-10h 599},{boarding-24h 699}]; POST quote base 2500 -> 10000.
measured_before.sitting_after_activation_at_1777: GET packages UNCHANGED [{sitting-visit-60 399},{sitting-overnight 799}]; POST quote base 1777 -> 3554.

measured_after.boarding: GET packages [{boarding-4h 499},{boarding-10h 599},{boarding-24h 2500}]; POST quote base 2500 -> 10000. The card and the panel agree.
measured_after.nothing_activated_control: GET packages unchanged at the seeded catalogue prices, each labelled price_source 'fallback_default'; POST quote unchanged. Identical to before the fix.

consequence_closed: app/boarding/page.tsx renders `money(item.base_price_per_pet) / pet / unit` from the GET and the sticky quote panel directly underneath renders the POST's totalAmount. A customer picked a card saying Rs 699 per pet per unit and the panel beneath it said Rs 10,000 for the same two-night, two-pet stay. There was no third surface to arbitrate and nothing on the page explaining the difference, for as long as any operator price was active in Pricing Control. app/sitting/page.tsx had the same split through activePackage.base_price_per_pet.
rule_source: lib/live-pricing-resolver.ts is documented as the single bridge between the operator's Pricing Control state and the customer price. createLiveBoardingQuote and createLiveSittingQuote cross it; the listing endpoints feeding the same screens did not. Nothing about what a price SHOULD be is decided here - only that both halves of one screen read the same source.

files_changed: lib/live-commercial-quotes.ts - new listLiveBoardingPackages and listLiveSittingPackages, one resolveLivePrice per listed package, beside the quote builders that already own this bridge
app/api/boarding-commercial/route.ts - GET lists through listLiveBoardingPackages with the cityId/zoneId/scheduledStart it already receives

app/api/sitting-commercial/route.ts - GET lists through listLiveSittingPackages; it accepts cityId/zoneId now, defaulting to the same blr/blr-east the sibling Boarding GET already defaults to, because Pricing Control rules are scoped by city and zone
lib/sitting-commercial-client.ts - loadSittingCatalogue forwards the customer's cityId/zoneId
fix.fallback_contract_preserved: Quoted from lib/live-pricing-resolver.ts: 'If the row remains inactive, callers get their pre-existing fallback unchanged.' A package with no active Pricing Control row is returned with its catalogue price untouched and labelled price_source 'fallback_default'. Resolving every card is not a way to rewrite a price nobody activated.
fix.extra_pet: createLiveSittingQuote resolves `<code>__extra_pet` as a package of its own, so the listing does too - the card renders a second-pet price beside the first, and leaving that on the catalogue value would reopen the same split one pet later.

sabotage_verification: Both GETs reverted to the raw catalogue listers (the original defect) -> all 5 fail.
The fallback case relabelled as 'pricing_control' with the price untouched -> cases 3 and 4 fail, 3 pass. The fallback contract's surface-truth half is locked separately from the price half.
The extra-pet resolve removed -> case 5 fails alone, 4 pass.
non_vacuity_controls: case 3: with nothing activated, the catalogue price is the seeded one and the quote agrees - exactly as before this fix. Returning the operator's price unconditionally would fail here.
case 4: activating boarding-24h does not move boarding-4h, which keeps its catalogue price and its fallback_default label.

gates.test_churn: none - no existing assertion was changed, updated or removed
